title_zh: 通勤共益公地任务书交付图谱
boundary_note_zh: 品牌、区域协同、案例转译、地标和活动均为概念成果，不代表合作、投资、审批、建设、运营或活动承诺。
boundary_note_en: Brand, regional interfaces, case transfer, landmarks and events are conceptual outputs, not partnership, investment, approval, construction, operation or event commitments.

identity.mark_logic_zh: 通勤请求与公共回程共享同一放行门：没有普通、无障碍和人工等价路径，就不扩张企业窗口。
identity.mark_logic_en: A commute request and public return share one release gate: no enterprise window expands without ordinary, accessible and human-equivalent paths.

palette.name: public_route
palette.meaning_zh: 普通与无障碍公共路线

palette.name: enterprise_request
palette.meaning_zh: 企业到岗、装卸与服务请求
palette.meaning_en: enterprise arrival, loading and service request

use_rules: use system fonts and self-authored geometry only
never combine the mark with enterprise or government logos
every public use carries concept and release-status wording

positioning.flow_commons_move_zh: 把京张工程、到站、换乘、维护和回家组织成可核验、可更正的公共通勤档案。
positioning.flow_commons_move_en: Organise Jing-Zhang engineering, arrival, transfer, maintenance and return-home into a verifiable, correctable public commute archive.

positioning.zh: 都市 AI 生活体验带
positioning.flow_commons_move_zh: 每个数字调度同时展示普通路线、无障碍替代、人工入口和失败回家路径。
positioning.flow_commons_move_en: Show the ordinary route, accessible alternative, human entry and failure-return path beside every digital dispatch.

positioning.flow_commons_move_zh: 企业到岗、路缘和接驳测试先过公共交通、公平、责任、隐私与撤回硬门。
positioning.flow_commons_move_en: Pass transit, equity, responsibility, privacy and withdrawal gates before enterprise arrival, curb or feeder tests.

functions.zh: AI 全栈自主创新体系
functions.interface: versioned multimodal model, grouped input replacement and human takeover

functions.zh: 世界级 AI 创新生态
functions.interface: six public mechanisms, eight resources and five regional interfaces
ten cards, full-day service-equivalence receipts and stop rules

functions.zh: 智能化 AI 活力城市
functions.interface: station-to-home ordinary, accessible and night-return chains
public status, refusal, repair, appeal and retirement records

three_areas_two_wings.zh: 众智园 AI 自主创新加速区
three_areas_two_wings.role_zh: 企业到岗、装卸与班车窗口的责任起点；普通和无障碍路线优先
three_areas_two_wings.role_en: responsibility origin for enterprise arrival, loading and feeder windows; ordinary and accessible routes first

three_areas_two_wings.role_zh: 居民照护、日常出行、无障碍和夜间人工回退的最小 P0
three_areas_two_wings.role_en: minimum P0 for care, daily trips, accessibility and night human fallback

three_areas_two_wings.zh: 大钟寺 AI 产业集聚区
three_areas_two_wings.role_zh: 轨道—公交—路缘换乘、活动降容和投诉结案界面
three_areas_two_wings.role_en: rail-bus-curb transfer, event downshift and complaint closeout interface

three_areas_two_wings.role_zh: 资金、人才、算力、数据、专业服务和跨区通勤的条件接口
three_areas_two_wings.role_en: conditional interface for capital, talent, compute, data, professional service and cross-area commute

three_areas_two_wings.role_zh: 慢行、蓝绿、社区日常和到站—回家链的回读接口
three_areas_two_wings.role_en: readback interface for active travel, blue-green space, daily life and station-to-home chains

global_cases.name: Helsinki AI Register
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 公开 AI 系统用途、责任与反馈入口
global_cases.mechanism_en: public purpose, accountability and feedback entry
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 给每个交通试点一张状态卡和投诉入口
global_cases.local_transfer_en: give every mobility pilot a status card and complaint route
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 登记册不能替代安全、无障碍和居民同意
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: a register cannot replace safety, accessibility or resident consent

global_cases.name: Amsterdam Algorithm Register
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 解释算法如何影响城市服务
global_cases.mechanism_en: explain how algorithms affect city services
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 把人工等价服务、申诉和停止状态放在同一页
global_cases.local_transfer_en: place human equivalent, appeal and stop state on one page
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 不把海外登记当本地合规证明
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: do not treat a foreign register as local compliance proof

global_cases.name: Singapore AI Verify
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 标准化测试、开源协作和保证沙盒
global_cases.mechanism_en: standardised testing, open collaboration and assurance sandbox
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 把众智园窗口绑定模型卡、接管演练和撤回回执
global_cases.local_transfer_en: bind the Zhongzhiyuan window to a model card, takeover drill and withdrawal receipt
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 测试工具不是认证或运营许可
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: a test tool is not certification or operating permission

global_cases.name: Decidim Barcelona
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 可追踪的线上线下协作参与
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 数字台账配套纸面、电话、步入式反馈和变更回读
global_cases.local_transfer_en: pair the digital ledger with paper, phone, walk-in feedback and change readback
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 数字参与不能替代无设备和语言支持
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: digital participation cannot replace device-free and language access

global_cases.name: UK Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 结构化记录目的、数据、人工复核和限制
global_cases.mechanism_en: structured record of purpose, data, human review and limits
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 形成企业—居民窗口的九字段公开预检单
global_cases.local_transfer_en: create a nine-field public preflight for each enterprise-resident window
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 英国标准不是北京法定要求
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: the UK standard is not a Beijing statutory requirement

global_cases.name: Seoul AI Foundation
global_cases.mechanism_zh: 研究、公共服务、人才和全球协作的机构能力
global_cases.mechanism_en: institutional capacity across research, public service, talent and global collaboration
global_cases.local_transfer_zh: 把年度活动接到真实问题、试点回执和人才后续路径
global_cases.local_transfer_en: connect annual events to real problems, pilot receipts and talent follow-through
global_cases.do_not_copy_zh: 不声称机构合作、资金或同级授权
global_cases.do_not_copy_en: do not claim institutional partnership, funding or equivalent mandate

landmarks.anchor_zh: 京张遗址公园公共界面
landmarks.anchor_en: public edge of the Jing-Zhang heritage park
landmarks.public_function_zh: 显示一个工程问题、来源、普通路线和撤下入口
landmarks.public_function_en: show one engineering question, source, ordinary route and removal route
landmarks.acceptance_zh: 无账户可读；来源和版权可查；不阻断慢行与消防
landmarks.acceptance_en: readable without an account; source and rights traceable; active travel and fire access remain open

landmarks.public_function_zh: 把开发者贡献与居民问题、人工帮助和更正记录配对
landmarks.public_function_en: pair developer contributions with resident questions, human help and correction records
landmarks.acceptance_zh: 贡献可更正或撤回；不保存连续个人行为
landmarks.acceptance_en: a contribution can be corrected or withdrawn; no continuous personal behaviour is retained

landmarks.anchor_zh: 大钟寺站任务锚点概念界面
landmarks.anchor_en: conceptual interface at the Dazhongsi task anchor
landmarks.public_function_zh: 显示活动容量、普通回程、责任人、暂停与复原状态
landmarks.public_function_en: show event capacity, ordinary return, owner, pause and restoration state
landmarks.acceptance_zh: 四象限连续路线和夜间人工回退可见；未获锚点前不落位
landmarks.acceptance_en: four-quadrant continuity and night human fallback are visible; no siting before an official anchor

culture_story.zh: 从京张铁路把城市连接起来，到中关村把知识开放出来，再到 AI 时代把每次调度的来源、责任、失败、申诉和回家路径公开：通勤效率必须带着公共回程一起前进。
culture_story.en: From the Jing-Zhang railway connecting the city, through Zhongguancun opening knowledge, to AI-era dispatch that publishes source, responsibility, failure, appeal and the way home: commute efficiency advances only with a public return.
culture_story.international_copy: Every intelligent commute owes the city a public way home.

annual_operations.output_zh: 公开问题、来源、权利边界与招募说明
annual_operations.output_en: public questions, sources, rights boundary and invitation
annual_operations.conversion_zh: 问题进入开发者队列或退回补证
annual_operations.conversion_en: question enters a developer queue or returns for evidence
annual_operations.stop_zh: 来源、权利或公共价值不清即不发布
annual_operations.stop_en: do not publish when source, rights or public value is unclear

annual_operations.output_zh: 逐段走查、人工路线、分组计数与修复工单
annual_operations.output_en: segment walk, human route, grouped counts and repair work order
annual_operations.conversion_zh: 只把通过硬门的最小链送入 P1
annual_operations.conversion_en: send only a hard-gate-passing minimum chain to P1
annual_operations.stop_zh: 参与者不安全、路线断裂或无接管人即停止
annual_operations.stop_en: stop for participant risk, broken route or absent takeover

annual_operations.output_zh: 模型卡、失败、申诉、更正和退出摘要
annual_operations.output_en: model card, failure, appeal, correction and exit summary
annual_operations.conversion_zh: 继续、修复或退役决定进入公开账本
annual_operations.conversion_en: continue, repair or retire decision enters the public ledger
annual_operations.stop_zh: 个人数据、权利不清或无法复现即撤下
annual_operations.stop_en: remove for personal data, unclear rights or irreproducibility

annual_operations.output_zh: 跨区域案例比较、年度证据账和下一年问题
annual_operations.output_en: regional case comparison, annual evidence ledger and next-year questions
annual_operations.conversion_zh: 人才、场景和专业团队进入有责任人的后续任务
annual_operations.conversion_en: talent, scenarios and professional teams enter owned follow-up tasks
annual_operations.stop_zh: 不以到场量替代公共收益和问题结案
annual_operations.stop_en: attendance never replaces public benefit or issue closeout

regional_synergy.role_zh: 居民日常与照护需求接口
regional_synergy.exchange: grouped demand, ordinary route, accessibility and repair readback

regional_synergy.role_zh: 科研人才跨区通勤接口
regional_synergy.role_en: cross-area commute interface for research talent
regional_synergy.exchange: grouped OD, rail-bus chain, shift windows and no-car fallback

regional_synergy.role_zh: 长距离科研活动与弹性出行接口
regional_synergy.role_en: long-distance research activity and flexible-travel interface
regional_synergy.exchange: event windows, transfer reliability, weather fallback and overnight return

regional_synergy.role_zh: 制造与产业班次通勤接口
regional_synergy.exchange: shift groups, feeder-transit competition, logistics conflict and capacity unknowns

regional_synergy.role_zh: 跨城公共交通与人才往返接口
regional_synergy.exchange: intercity rail, first-last mile, grouped denominators and responsibility handoff
